name: Zhao Mengfu Writing the Heart (Hridaya) Sutra in Exchange for Tea
material: handscroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: The Yuan dynasty calligrapher Zhao Mengfu (1254–1322) is said to have transcribed the Heart Sutra for a certain priest named Li in exchange for tea.
